_comment: Slugs retired 2026-09-19: these 31 pages sat in Search Console as 'Discovered – currently not indexed' for weeks and were taken down (404) rather than left to dilute the crawl budget. Their content stays in the *.py files so a slug can be revived by removing it from this list and rebuilding. The /nation-in-cursive/ hub was removed at the same time; the six kept pages (america, australia, canada, england, ireland, united-states) had clicks.
